title: Variable Stepsize Distributed Forward-Backward Splitting Methods as Relocated Fixed-Point Iterations
summary: We present a family of distributed forward-backward methods with variable stepsizes to find a solution of structured monotone inclusion problems. The framework is constructed by means of relocated fixed-point iterations, extending the approach introduced in [SIAM J. Optim. 2026; 36(3):1297-1325] to conically averaged operators, thus including iteration operators for methods of forward-backward type devised by graphs.
